name: Cassia gum
aliases: E427, cassia gum, cassia seed gum, cassia galactomannan, Cassia tora gum, Cassia obtusifolia gum, goma cassia
what_is: A purified galactomannan-rich material from the endosperm of Cassia tora and Cassia obtusifolia seeds, used as a thickener, stabiliser and gelling agent.
why_botia: Cassia gum comes from a plant related to senna. It thickens by retaining water, and its international specification is still tentative: JECFA has not made it final and additional data are still pending.
can_1: Identify E427 or cassia gum when declared on the label.
